name: Locomotive
statusReason: Locomotive's scroll and page motion run through Lenis, GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Barba and three.js. None exposed GSAP on window, so the scroll-linked moves aren't readable. The CSS layer below is what the tool could see.
summary: Project images widen on hover over 0.45s on quint-out and shrink back in 0.2s, the preloader logo appears on a 0.9s cubic-out, and the header answers in 0.2s. The big moves are in JavaScript.

tiers.label: project image narrowing as the pointer leaves

honestyNote: The project image animates width, which triggers layout on every frame. Five prefers-reduced-motion queries are in the CSS, but the 16 movement events seen ran the same with reduced motion on.
notes: A faster exit, by state: the hover rule says 0.45s and the resting rule says 0.2s, so arriving takes more than twice as long as leaving.
The two long curves are the usual stand-ins for cubic-out (0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1) and quint-out (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).
